label: Binance (ccxt) candles
auth: optional api key/secret (ccxt config; public endpoints work keyless)

adapter.rate_note: REQUEST_WEIGHT 6000 per minute per IP; klines weight 2, exchangeInfo weight 20, ping 1; HTTP 429 carries Retry-After and repeated violations earn a 418 IP ban (https://developers.binance.com/docs/binance-spot-api-docs/rest-api/general-api-information). The collector uses ccxt over the same public endpoints; keys are optional there and not needed for market data.

me.note: Public market-data host, no credentials: the probe is GET /api/v3/ping (weight 1, empty object).

get_candles.note: Kline/candlestick rows are positional arrays [openTime, open, high, low, close, volume, closeTime, quoteVolume, trades, takerBuyBase, takerBuyQuote, ignore] mapped by index (`raw.values` keeps the row). `interval`: 1s, 1m, 3m, 5m, 15m, 30m, 1h, 2h, 4h, 6h, 8h, 12h, 1d, 3d, 1w, 1M. `start`/`end` are startTime/endTime in epoch MILLISECONDS (pass the number as a string); `time` is the open time in ms and prices/volume are Binance's decimal strings. limit default 500, max 1000 (weight 2). Rows carry prices as decimal strings (and Binance the open time as an integer); they are returned as numbers and `time` as a string, as the vocabulary types them (live check 2026-09-26: the raw values failed the output schema).

search_symbols.note: exchangeInfo has no text search: `query` is sent as the exact `symbol` filter (e.g. BTCUSDT; an unknown symbol is a 400 'Invalid symbol' error) and the whole symbol list comes back when it is omitted — pagination is not supported, `page`/`limit` are ignored. `name` is the baseAsset, `type` the trading status; quoteAsset, precisions, orderTypes, permissions and filters stay in `raw`.

not_offered.get_series: No named time series on the spot market-data API (funding/open interest live on the futures hosts, which this entry does not cover).
not_offered.get_news: No news endpoint on this API.
